risks.risk: Accepted workflow programmes record the design/review documents they were compiled from in an immutable 'source:' field (governance/workflow-programs/simple/v1.yaml names the simple@v1 design and broad review explicitly), and the repository policy forbids any Run from writing governance paths. Moving those documents makes an immutable provenance field stale.
risks.mitigation: Do not edit accepted programme YAML. Leave the stale path and add a one-line redirect note in the archive group directory.

risks.risk: governance/work-items/*-task.txt and governance/commissions/*/task.md embed document paths as historical Run inputs. They are the dominant source of the 124 dangling references.
risks.mitigation: Adopt and state the rule: frozen Run records keep their original paths and are never retro-edited.

risks.risk: docs/README.adoc assigns an authority class to each directory. Moving documents between warm_storage, cold_storage, architecture/ and future/ silently changes their declared class. Front Door maintainer decision records in particular must not drift into 'historical'.
risks.mitigation: Update docs/README.adoc in the same commit as each move, never later.

risks.risk: _open.adoc derives live scope from the MVP concept that is headed for future/. Moving it first would leave the roadmap citing a document now classified as speculative.
risks.mitigation: Re-cite _open.adoc against the maintainer decision records BEFORE that move.

risks.risk: Sibling clones exist at different HEADs: workflow-coordinator-runtime (5cf0fe1a, the accepted Runtime), workflow-coordinator-docs (076fc2e), wfc (4edcea0, 2026-10-02), workflow-coordinator-run-evidence (c76f9d8). Path changes here do not reach them until promotion.
risks.mitigation: Finish the restructure before the next Runtime promotion; no action needed on the clones.

risks.risk: This work is being done by direct agent development, so none of it passes through WFC admission, review or evidence gates, and tests/architecture/test_self_development_governance.py (7731 lines, 44 tests) may assert on governance and document paths.
risks.mitigation: Run make check after each batch; the test suite is the only gate this work has.
